_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR local fixture paths. Tests only ever open copies of these files.

_notes.clientTemplate: An unprepared client Service template (subline as real text on its 'text' layer).
_notes.preparedTemplate: The Prepare output of clientTemplate, in the SAME folder, still holding <<SERVICE SUBLINE>> placeholders.
_notes.sourceImage: Any product photo; used as the placed image.
_notes.expectedClientSubline: Start of the client's real subline on page 1 (checked after recovery).
_notes.twoLayoutPages: 1-based pages of preparedTemplate kept for the 2-layout fixture (e.g. 800x600 bottom + 250x250 thumbnail).
